title: First-Touch Channel Attribution
description:
Each conversion (`conversions.customer_id`) is attributed to the channel the customer's **first-ever** touch (`touches`) came from. A customer may have touches after converting too — only the earliest touch counts.

Report each channel's `channel`, `conversions` (count attributed) and `share` — `ROUND(conversions / total conversions, 2)`. Customers with no touch at all are not attributed to any channel. Return channels in any order.
solutionSql:
WITH first_touch AS (
  SELECT t.customer_id, t.channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.touch_date, t.id) AS rn
  FROM touches t
  JOIN conversions c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
  WHERE t.touch_date <= c.conversion_date
),
attributed AS (
  SELECT customer_id, channel
  FROM first_touch
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS conversions,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attributed), 2) AS share
FROM attributed
GROUP BY channel;
hint: Pick each customer's single earliest touch (ROW_NUMBER), then GROUP BY channel. Attribution counts customers, not touch rows.
outputExplanation: Customer 1 first touched via 'ads', customer 2 via 'email', customer 3 via 'ads' → ads 2, email 1, share 0.67 / 0.33.
